items.title: Pay "processing fee" to receive refund
items.quote: überweisen Sie bitte die einmalige Bearbeitungsgebühr von 49,90 € bis zum 27.11.2026 auf das Konto IBAN CY17 0020 0128 0000 0012 0052 7600.
items.computation: The letter states an explicit calendar date, 27.11.2026, as the deadline for paying the fee. No period calculation is needed. However, this entire scheme (pay a fee to a foreign IBAN to 'unlock' a refund) is a well-known advance-fee / phishing scam pattern and the payment should NOT actually be made.

warnings: This is almost certainly a scam: a genuine energy refund would never require the recipient to pay an upfront 'processing fee' to a foreign (Cypriot) bank account before receiving money owed to them — this is a classic advance-fee fraud pattern.

The sender's address and IBAN are both in Cyprus (Zypern), which is highly unusual and suspicious for a German consumer energy refund office; the name 'Verbraucher-Rückerstattungsstelle Energie' does not correspond to any known German authority or regulator.
The letter uses pressure tactics ('Verstreicht die Frist, verfällt Ihr Anspruch endgültig.') to rush the recipient into paying quickly without verification — a typical scam technique.
Do NOT send the 49,90 € fee or any money to the IBAN provided; legitimate refunds are never conditioned on an upfront payment to an unrelated foreign account.
Recommend verifying independently (e.g., with Verbraucherzentrale NRW or the Bundesnetzagentur) and not responding to this letter; consider reporting it as fraud.
